title: Reject CalendarEvent/get with utcStart/utcEnd plus recurrenceOverrides
description: 4d7d50e (#450): MUST return invalidArguments when properties requests utcStart/utcEnd together with recurrenceOverrides. Not checked: event.rs:170-173 only computes want_utc. Add the check and a test. The expandRecurrences half of the commit is already enforced (event.rs:1262-1269, test lib.rs:2189-2194).
